full_observation: Across 8 approximate chemical properties, trained embeddings changed cross-validated linear readability by +0.003 R² on average relative to matched random initialization.
full_confounder: Only 33 tags map cleanly to a central element; oxide tags duplicate some cations, and common valence/ionic radius are coordination-dependent approximations.
full_next_step: Retest any positive property with a curated, citation-backed mineral-specific property table and leave-one-element-family-out validation.

experiment_name: Geochemical affinity and expected element neighbors
full_observation: Only 7/12 prespecified similarity pairs are testable. The combined trained-over-random pair/group effect is -0.001.
full_confounder: Geochemical group assignments overlap and are context-dependent; six canonical pairs cannot be tested because one or both tags were never trained.
full_next_step: Prioritize only permutation-stable group effects; extending the vocabulary is required before claiming broad Goldschmidt or substitution structure.

full_observation: The trained vocabulary contains only La_ppm, Ce_ppm, Nd_ppm, Yb_ppm; their PC1 ordering correlation with atomic number is 0.400 versus 0.200 at random initialization.
full_confounder: Four irregularly spaced REE tags cannot establish an LREE–MREE–HREE sequence or test Ce/Eu anomalies. PCA sign and axis selection are unstable at n=4.
full_next_step: Treat this as a coverage audit, not evidence of a learned REE manifold; retraining with a complete REE panel is required.

full_observation: Across all 34 numeric tags, the median trained MLP trajectory has PC1 monotonicity 1.000, straightness 0.823, and outer/central sensitivity ratio 0.465.
full_confounder: The grid is in per-field robust-z space, so equal steps do not mean equal absolute or log-fold concentration changes. This tests encoder geometry, not natural-sample frequency.
full_next_step: Investigate fields with low monotonicity, low straightness, or strong edge compression against empirical quantiles and detection-limit coverage.

full_observation: In the pre-Transformer two-token mean, ratio-changing perturbations move 0.463 times as far as common positive shifts, compared with 0.608 for the matched random encoder.
full_confounder: A token-wise MLP has no access to other elements or closure; this is a geometric superposition test, not evidence that the model explicitly represents geochemical ratios.
full_next_step: Repeat the same perturbations through the Transformer on closed synthetic compositions (F3) before assigning relative-composition semantics.

full_observation: Trained field value directions have mean cross-field cosine 0.861 and norm CV 0.589; random values are 0.450 and 0.073.
full_confounder: A shared MLP mechanically encourages some common direction even before training. Per-field robust scaling also makes equal z steps distributional rather than physically equivalent.
full_next_step: Compare equal empirical quantiles and equal log-fold changes separately for major and trace fields.

full_observation: The source view and V2 tokenization do not preserve detection-limit/censoring states, so near-limit geometry cannot be identified.
full_confounder: Required state is absent from the trained model/data environment.
full_next_step: Add explicit censored-value state tokens in a future model before testing detection-limit semantics.

experiment_name: Same value in different rock backgrounds
full_observation: At nearly fixed element value, contextual tokens improve mafic/intermediate/felsic background readability by +0.521 balanced accuracy on average across 6 fields.
full_confounder: SiO₂ background is a coarse proxy, and contextual tokens can exploit reporting patterns or correlated fields rather than mineralogical role.
full_next_step: For fields with the largest gain, match samples additionally on token coverage and publication before interpreting context as geological role.

full_observation: Across 7 predeclared element/process proxies, contextualization changes low/mid/high proxy readability by +0.221 balanced accuracy on average.
full_confounder: Mg#, Sr/Y, MALI, and SiO₂ are process proxies, not unique process labels; high readability can reflect direct compositional covariance.
full_next_step: Only follow fields whose contextual gain remains after value-bin, publication, and missingness matching.

full_observation: Contextualization increases geology-label neighbor purity by +0.131 and source/reference purity by +0.128; net geology-over-source gain is +0.003.
full_confounder: Token reservoir is capped uniformly by field and the model was trained with hierarchical rock labels; neighbor purity is descriptive, not independent generalization.
full_next_step: Inspect per-field cases where source gain dominates and repeat with publication-grouped matching.

full_observation: Chemistry-only encoded-mean latent has rock-type kNN15 purity 0.400 versus 0.270 for transformed values plus observation mask.
full_confounder: The checkpoint used rock labels during full-data training, so rock-label organization is decodability, not out-of-sample discovery. Missingness is present in both spaces.
full_next_step: Interpret only gradients or neighborhoods that improve over raw chemistry and remain stable under publication/source controls.

full_observation: Encoded-mean geology purity is 0.611 versus raw 0.544; encoded source/reference purity is 0.340 and is reported separately as a confounder.
full_confounder: Source purity and geology purity are not on identical class-cardinality baselines; publication IDs also proxy real suites and localities.
full_next_step: Use explicit publication-grouped retrieval and spatial distance bins for any neighborhood selected as a candidate result.

experiment_name: Global linear and nonlinear latent directions
full_observation: For the predeclared geochemical gradients, the mean strongest single PCA-axis |ρ| is 0.477 in encoded latent versus 0.605 in the raw transformed baseline.
full_confounder: PCA axes are rotation-dependent and several derived indices are deterministic functions of model inputs. The attempted spectral nonlinear scan crashed in native code and is recorded separately rather than silently removed.
full_next_step: Promote only gradients that are smooth in high-dimensional neighborhoods and repeat across seeds/sample subsets before fitting a geological principal curve.

full_observation: The low-cost spectral/diffusion proxy terminated the Python process with native exit code 139 after the linear D3 tables had been written.
full_confounder: Likely BLAS/OpenMP/native eigensolver interaction in the current macOS CPU environment; no geological conclusion can be drawn from this failure.
full_next_step: Retry the nonlinear graph analysis in an isolated process with one BLAS thread, or use a validated diffusion-map environment.

full_observation: Encoded neighbors have median geographic separation 5933.3 km versus 6015.6 km in raw chemistry.
full_confounder: Coordinates may be rounded or publication-level, and geographic proximity can represent real suites as well as leakage.
full_next_step: Use spatial cells jointly with canonical publication IDs for a stricter neighborhood audit.

full_observation: For external isotope/age targets with at least 5% coverage, publication-grouped latent R² averages 0.255, versus 0.178 for raw transformed chemistry.
full_confounder: Isotope coverage is sparse and publication-specific; grouped folds reduce but do not eliminate analytical-source confounding.
full_next_step: Inspect only targets with positive held-publication R² and adequate coverage before geological interpretation.

full_observation: Eight linear/closed two-endmember paths have mean latent ordering 0.961 and straightness 0.354; closure changes straightness by -0.005 on average.
full_confounder: Median endmembers combine unrelated publications and are not physical coexisting endmembers. Linear oxide mixing and major closure omit density, volatile, and mineralogical constraints.
full_next_step: Promote only curved or branch-specific behavior that is reproducible with natural suites or physically constrained endmembers.

full_observation: The closed basalt–rhyolite–limestone simplex preserves barycentric distance ranks at Spearman ρ=0.920 in chemistry-only latent space.
full_confounder: Distance-rank preservation does not prove triangular topology; the three median endmembers are synthetic and may pass through compositions absent from nature.
full_next_step: If retained, visualize edge/interior topology and compare with raw log-ratio space using the same points.

full_observation: Natural chemistry-only class centroids show mean primitive→evolved ordering 0.850; volcanic/plutonic endpoint directions have cosine 0.835.
full_confounder: Rock_type is chemistry-derived, class centroids mix unrelated suites, and label supervision was used in checkpoint training.
full_next_step: Repeat within publication/locality-defined suites before treating the direction as magmatic fractionation.

full_observation: Four simplified source/residual melting branches have mean F ordering 1.000 in latent space.
full_confounder: Partition coefficients are broad proxies, major elements are held fixed, and the V2 vocabulary lacks a complete REE panel; this is a geometry stress test, not petrological modeling.
full_next_step: Only pursue source/residual branching after replacing proxy coefficients with a documented mineral-mode model.

full_observation: Leaching and K-metasomatism proxy paths have mean ordering 1.000; endpoint directions have cosine 0.748.
full_confounder: The perturbation is a compositional proxy, not a mass-balanced weathering model; closure can conflate leaching with relative enrichment.
full_next_step: Compare against natural CIA-matched samples and isocon-style mass-change constraints before geological interpretation.

full_observation: Three idealized alteration proxies are individually ordered at 1.000; their mean direction cosine is 0.120.
full_confounder: No alteration labels or fresh–altered pairs exist in the trained view; closure and arbitrary magnitude choices dominate this synthetic test.
full_next_step: Keep as a stress test only unless paired natural alteration data become available.

experiment_name: Metamorphic inheritance within matched rock type
full_observation: There are 11 rock_type strata with at least ten metamorphic and ten non-metamorphic samples; their mean centroid cosine distance is 0.113.
full_confounder: Rock_group metamorphic may encode protolith inheritance and naming practices; no metamorphic grade or paired protolith sample is available.
full_next_step: If any strata are stable after source matching, analyze them as protolith-preservation cases rather than a universal metamorphic direction.

full_observation: A 20% closed major-element perturbation from rhyolite toward the basalt median aligns with the natural rhyolite→basalt latent centroid direction at mean cosine 0.293.
full_confounder: Class directions are label-contaminated, and the perturbation changes only major oxides while natural basalt/rhyolite differences include trace elements and source effects.
full_next_step: Repeat with multiple perturbation sizes and publication-matched class centroids if alignment is stable.

full_observation: Single-field +0.5z interventions have mean direction cosine 0.395 across mafic, intermediate, and felsic backgrounds.
full_confounder: Changing one transformed token ignores closure and may create impossible compositions; response directions include attention redistribution and missingness context.
full_next_step: Fields with low consistency are candidates for genuine contextual role changes, but require compositionally valid perturbations.

full_observation: Four geochemical multi-field interventions have mean actual-versus-additive direction cosine 0.942 and interaction residual ratio 0.374 across three backgrounds.
full_confounder: Interventions operate in independently standardized z units and do not enforce closure; high additivity can be architectural rather than geological.
full_next_step: Retain only strongly non-additive, background-stable combinations for compositionally closed follow-up tests.

full_observation: Pure-label embeddings have field-identity kNN5 purity 0.776, versus 0.772 before training.
full_confounder: Field identity is encoded directly in token names and separate field-level mask tasks, so field clustering is not geological semantic evidence by itself.
full_next_step: Inspect within-rock_type neighbors and compare their distance structure with chemistry-only class centroids (H3).

full_observation: Across 7 available pairs, the trained volcanic→plutonic relation has mean pairwise cosine 0.652 and leave-one-pair-out MRR 0.269.
full_confounder: Rock-type labels are partly computed from chemistry and share lexical/classification structure; a global translation may obscure local nonlinear relations.
full_next_step: Repeat any positive relation in chemistry-only class-centroid space and test whether relation structure agrees across spaces (H3).

full_observation: Only 0/6 prespecified protolith–metamorphic rock_type pairs are present; the relation algebra is not testable in the trained pure-label vocabulary.
full_confounder: The database rock_type is a chemistry-derived classification and does not preserve metamorphic grade/name labels such as slate, phyllite, schist, or marble.
full_next_step: Use rock_group/protolith metadata in a separately trained vocabulary if metamorphic relation semantics are a research target.

full_observation: The two prespecified volcanic and plutonic evolution sequences have mean trained PC1 monotonicity 0.600, compared with 0.050 at initialization.
full_confounder: With only five labels per sequence, PCA ordering is unstable and does not prove a globally linear magmatic-evolution axis.
full_next_step: Compare sequence ordering with chemistry-only sample centroids and natural-suite trajectories.

full_observation: Available alkaline-shift relation vectors have mean cosine 0.237 versus 0.166 at random initialization.
full_confounder: The three label pairs do not represent identical petrogenetic comparisons and one is not a strict paired equivalent.
full_next_step: Treat as exploratory; validate against total-alkali-matched chemistry-only class centroids.

representation_level: chemistry-only sample latent versus projected label token
full_observation: Without an alignment map, direct cosine retrieval places the true rock_type first for 2.333% of chemistry-only samples and in the top five for 6.800%.
full_confounder: Projected pure-label tokens and contextual pooled sample latents are different representation levels; direct cosine is a diagnostic and may be geometrically invalid.
full_next_step: Use the constrained class-centroid alignment experiment H2 before interpreting cross-space similarity.

full_observation: A 24D ridge map trained on all other classes retrieves the held-out class centroid at top-1 rate 0.053 across 75 rock types.
full_confounder: Class centroids and label embeddings both inherit training labels; leave-one-class-out limits mapping capacity but is not an independent test set.
full_next_step: Compare relation-distance preservation without fitted mapping (H3) and rerun on publication-held-out class centroids if pursued.

full_observation: Pairwise rock-type relation distances agree between projected label space and chemistry-only class-centroid space at Spearman ρ=0.049 (permutation p=0.02).
full_confounder: Both spaces were produced by one label-supervised full-data checkpoint; relation agreement may reflect the supervised objective rather than emergent unsupervised geology.
full_next_step: Inspect which class pairs drive agreement and test against raw-chemistry centroid distances.

full_observation: Experiment failed: NotImplementedError
full_confounder: technical failure
full_next_step: Inspect errors.log and rerun after fixing the recorded failure.

full_observation: The 24D latent predicts the CIPW-like NNLS mineral proxies at mean CV R²=0.624, versus 0.765 from the ten input oxides.
full_confounder: This is not a strict CIPW allocation: NNLS permits non-unique and mutually incompatible normative phases. It is a broad mineralogical proxy and is explicitly labeled as such.
full_next_step: Install or validate a formal CIPW implementation before promoting mineral-specific claims; retain this result only as a baseline audit.

full_observation: Latent kNN15 purity for four dominant normative-proxy assemblages is 0.884, versus 0.925 in oxide space.
full_confounder: Assemblage labels are derived by argmax from an approximate and non-unique NNLS norm, so they are not mineral observations.
full_next_step: Use only as a relative latent-versus-raw check until strict CIPW norms are available.

full_observation: Four ideal normative mixtures retrieve an expected rock family with mean reciprocal rank 0.650, versus chance-rank MRR 0.065.
full_confounder: Ideal oxide mixtures omit trace elements and may be out of the training distribution; expected families are broad and the norm construction is approximate.
full_next_step: Inspect retrieved neighbors and input-space distances before interpreting failures as model semantic failures.

representation_level: sample latent residual after label mapping
full_observation: After a simple label→centroid map, residual PCs have mean best |ρ|=0.224 with CIPW-like mineral proxies.
full_confounder: The alignment is fit on the same classes and the norm is approximate; selecting the best of 12 PCs inflates correlations and is exploratory only.
full_next_step: Use held-out classes and strict CIPW norms before interpreting any residual direction.

full_observation: Adding a 24D chemistry-only latent to eight traditional indicators changes balanced accuracy by +0.177 on average across rock_group, rock_origin, and top-15 rock_type.
full_confounder: The checkpoint was trained with these labels on the same full dataset; this measures conditional decodability and cannot establish independent predictive value.
full_next_step: Repeat only promising targets with an encoder trained outside each publication-held-out evaluation fold.

full_observation: Under canonical-publication grouped folds, adding latent changes indicator-only balanced accuracy by +0.101 on average.
full_confounder: Encoder weights still saw all publications and labels during pretraining; grouped probes therefore remain transductive decodability checks.
full_next_step: A publishable generalization test requires fold-specific pretraining or a disjoint external corpus.

experiment_name: Traditional, random, projected, contextual, and pooling baselines
full_observation: Encoded mean has rock-type kNN15 purity 0.459; the best raw/CLR/PCA traditional baseline reaches 0.251, and the random contextual encoder reaches 0.126.
full_confounder: Rock-type purity is label-contaminated by full-data multi-task training and can also be inflated by source/missingness structure.
full_next_step: Use this table as the common baseline for all promoted results; do not cite model metrics without the source-purity column.

full_observation: Encoded-mean latents from numeric-only and all-label-masked inference have mean cosine 0.974; numeric-only versus visible-label control is 0.934.
full_confounder: All modes use a model trained mostly with visible labels. Numeric-only and all-masked inputs are both distribution shifts, so agreement is reassuring but disagreement is not uniquely attributable.
full_next_step: Combine with explicit token-dropout and order-invariance tests in K3.

full_observation: Random token permutation preserves encoded-mean latent at mean cosine 1.00000000; random 30% token removal retains mean cosine 0.329.
full_confounder: Dropout is uniform over observed fields and does not mimic element-specific analytical panels or detection limits.
full_next_step: Repeat dropout by realistic analytical panels and field coverage strata for any robustness claim.

full_observation: Only the final full_model.pt and its same-step component state dicts are available; there are no epoch checkpoints for sensitivity analysis.
full_confounder: Required state is absent from the trained model/data environment.
full_next_step: Save periodic full checkpoints in future training runs.

full_observation: umap-learn is absent from the Element2Vec environment; PCA remained the primary reproducible visualization and no UMAP claim was made.
full_confounder: Required state is absent from the trained model/data environment.
full_next_step: Install a pinned UMAP environment only for auxiliary visualization, not primary evidence.

experiment_name: Automatic follow-up: C1 versus raw context under publication grouping
full_observation: The large C1 contextual signal survives publication grouping at 0.940, but full raw chemistry reaches 0.840; contextual-minus-raw is +0.100.
full_confounder: The background label is defined directly by SiO₂, which is present in raw context and attended by the contextual token. This tests context transmission, not information beyond chemistry.
full_next_step: Treat C1 as evidence that attention writes whole-sample context into a token, not as a novel geological discovery unless it exceeds raw-context controls on a nontrivial target.

experiment_name: Automatic follow-up: contextual role proxies versus raw chemistry
full_observation: After publication grouping, contextual role-proxy readability is 0.829, versus 0.853 from the full transformed chemical panel.
full_confounder: The process proxies are algebraic or strongly correlated functions of input chemistry, so matching raw performance is expected and exceeding it would require careful validation.
full_next_step: Promote only individual fields with a stable contextual-over-raw gain and a process target not algebraically defined by the inputs.

experiment_name: Automatic follow-up: volcanic–plutonic relation structure across spaces
representation_level: label relations and chemistry class-centroid relations
full_observation: Volcanic–plutonic relation similarity matrices agree between label and chemistry-only class-centroid spaces at ρ=0.321 (permutation p=0.2).
full_confounder: Both spaces inherit the same label-supervised checkpoint; this comparison avoids direct cross-space vector subtraction but not training-label contamination.
full_next_step: Only if relation structure is significant should individual analogy directions be examined within publication-held-out centroids.

experiment_name: Automatic follow-up: random encoder and missingness/source structure
representation_level: raw mask, random encoder, trained encoder
full_observation: On exactly matched samples, training changes rock-type purity by +0.316 and source purity by +0.000; mask-only source purity is 0.940.
full_confounder: A random set encoder can preserve or amplify analytical-panel patterns; sample_id ordering and source imbalance also affect this control despite matched rows.
full_next_step: Any promoted latent neighborhood result must report mask-only and random-encoder source purity on the same samples.
